description: Our community has a strong tradition of respecting and honoring the men and women who have served in our Armed Forces. Veterans contribute significantly to the character of our communities, and recognizing their service—both publicly and through local support—is an important responsibility.It is imperative we maintain and expand the ways our towns honor veterans, including: • Preserving Local Traditions: Ensuring that the Memorial Day parade continues each year so residents have the opportunity
title: Honor Our Veterans
